newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yield up on Bulgaria 1-wk T-bills, falls on 4-wk.
newsitem.headline: Yield up on Bulgaria 1-wk T-bills, falls on 4-wk.

text.p: Yield rose at Monday's auction of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry one-week discount T-bills but fell further on four-week discount T-bills, central bank figures showed.
The average yields to maturity on the two issues were 1.58 and 5.40 percent, respectively against 1.27 percent and 6.38 percent on Friday and 1.48 and 7.75 percent at Thursday's auctions.
Bids were received for a total of 41.650 billion levs of T-bills for today's auctions and the ministry approved all the bids at the offered prices.
The issues were offered with par values of 20 billion levs and 45 billion levs respectively and no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:

Bids received 7,259 million levs 34 390.5 million levs
